error.hint: Use the named fields and enums in stage_schemas and inspect preview.available_sources/available_metrics. Failed arguments did not alter the previous draft.
error.message: Choose one of allowed_actions and reference only declared sources and metrics.

next: Inspect each experiment and original location. A completed session produces an unaccepted proposal; explicit acceptance happens in Studio or the CLI.

full_evidence.notice: Each evidence sample reports its total and exact source path. After saving the proposal, the CLI preview includes all contributing records. Studio also provides the complete metric evidence.

review.verification_scope: Checks resolve declared selectors, units, arithmetic and original positions against these input bytes. They do not establish the scientific identity or truth of a supplied rationale.

stage_guidance: Reference an existing source. Declare its field unit, exact single-value where selectors, expected_count and expected_seeds as strings. A seed collection belongs in expected_seeds, not where. Omit statistics for a plain mean; unknown source units require abstention.

undo.notice: undo with empty arguments and a reason reverts the last successful stage. It consumes one action and retains every observed input hash. At most four undo actions are allowed.
